# status

Show the working tree status.

## JavaScript

```ts
git.status({ porcelain?: boolean, branch?: boolean, untrackedFiles?: 'no' | 'normal' | 'all', paths?: string[] })
```

## CLI

```bash
git --no-pager status [--porcelain] [--branch] [--untracked-files=<no|normal|all>] [<paths>...]
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | CLI | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `porcelain` | `--porcelain` | `boolean` | No | - | Machine-readable output. |
| `branch` | `--branch` | `boolean` | No | - | Include branch information. |
| `untrackedFiles` | `--untracked-files` | `'no' \| 'normal' \| 'all'` | No | `"normal"` | How to report untracked files. One of: `no`, `normal`, `all`. |
| `paths` | _positional_ | `string[]` | No | - | Limit the report to these paths. |

## Output

Parsed as `lines`. `result.data` is `string[]`. One entry per output line.

## Examples

**Machine-readable status**

```ts
await git.status({
  porcelain: true,
})
```

```bash
git --no-pager status --porcelain
```

**Status of one directory**

```ts
await git.status({
  porcelain: true,
  paths: ['src'],
})
```

```bash
git --no-pager status --porcelain -- src
```
